name: Adaptive Gloves
effect: Increases the wearer's Weapon Skill by 10 and Parry by 10%.

name: Apex Predator's Gloves
effect:
Whenever the wearer kills a target marked as prey, they gain a stackable bonus until the end of combat based on the enemy difficulty tier:
I-II: +25% of the Bounty Hunter's maximum wounds as temporary wounds.
III-IV: +(10 x prey's difficulty tier)% critical damage and + (2x Prey's difficulty tier)% critical hit chance.
V-VII: both of the above.

name: Augmented Gloves
effect: Grants the wearer +10 Weapon Skill and +5 Strength.

name: Avenger Gauntlets
effect: All attacks of opportunity deal an additional +AGI bonus damage.

name: Avenger Tactical Gauntlets
effect: Whenever the wearer is able to perform an attack of opportunity, they gain +1 stack of vengeance. The wearer's attacks of opportunity deal an additional +(AGI bonus * vengeance stacks) damage.

name: Death Dealer Gloves
effect: The wearer's damage is increased by 2% for each critical hit and for each enemy they killed until the end of combat.

name: Deflection Gloves
effect: These gloves allow the wearer to parry melee attacks with their ranged weapon using Ballistic Skill instead of Weapon Skill.

name: Elite Marksman Gloves
effect: The wearer gains +15 Ballistic Skill.

name: Freedom and Vengeance
effect:
Whenever the wearer performs a non-burst attack with a pistol, that attack pushes the enemy by 2 cells.
If the wearer kills an enemy with a pistol attack, they immediately reload it. Each pistol reload grants +5% critical hit chance for pistol attacks.

name: Gloves of Endurance
effect: Whenever the wearer of these gloves gets an injury or falls unconscious in combat, their allies gain a +1 bonus to damage.

name: Gloves of Rapid Desolation
effect: Increases the rate of fire of the wearer’s weapon by +1. Each time an enemy is killed, perplexed is inflicted on all other enemies in a 2-cell radius.

name: Grenadier's Gloves
effect: Using grenades costs -AP for the wearer. They also increase damage from grenades by +2.

name: Harrowing Gloves
effect: When the wearer uses Intimidation, the targets inflicted with intimidated also gain the staggered effect for 1 round.

name: Master Surgeon Gloves
effect: The wearer gains +25 Medicae. Each time the wearer uses a medikit, it provides an additional +(INT bonus + AGI bonus) temporary wounds.

name: Noble Silk Gloves
effect: The wearer gains a +5 bonus to Persuasion.

name: Operator's Gloves
effect: The wearer gains a +3 bonus to Tech-Use.

name: Power Grips
effect: Grants +10 Strength.

name: Recoil Gloves
effect: These gloves reduce the recoil of all automatic weapons by -50%.

name: Redemption Gauntlets
effect: The wearer's melee attacks made against enemies under the effect of Expose Weakness decrease the enemy's Strength and Agility by -10.

name: Riposte Gloves
effect: If the wearer is an Assassin and successfully dodges or parries an enemy's attack, it automatically creates an additional opening on that enemy on the side closest to the wearer.

name: Saboteur's Gloves
effect: Grants +15 bonus to Demolition.

name: Slayer's Delight
effect: Whenever the wearer performs a single-target attack with a 2-handed melee weapon, that attack deals +(3 x STR bonus) damage.

name: Sniper Gloves
effect:
The wearer deals +5% damage.
The wearer gains +5% critical hit chance to single shots and deadeye shots.

name: Stabiliser Bracers
effect: The wearer gains +10 Ballistic Skill and +25% critical damage.

name: Stabilising Bracers
effect: When the wearer uses Run and Gun, they gain a +(AGI bonus / 3) bonus damage on their ranged attacks.

name: Stalker Gloves
effect: If the wearer's ranged attack hits an enemy, the wearer gains a +5% bonus to critical hit chance for the next ranged attack against the same enemy. Does not stack.

name: The Hand of Avolius
effect:
After a successful attack, these gauntlets grant the wearer a 50% chance to inflict the bleeding effect on enemies that fail a Toughness test.
If the wearer has Dogmatic -- Adherent, the test is made with a -20 penalty.

name: Thrice-Pioneer's Bracers
effect: Every time the wearer deals damage, the target's Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill is reduced by -5 for 2 rounds. Stacks up to 6 times.

name: Torment Bracelets
effect:
If the wearer deals damage, their enemies suffer 1-3 Rending damage (with armour penetration of 10%) for each cell the enemy has moved during the wearer's turn.
Heretical - Adherent: the enemies suffer 1-6 warp damage instead.

name: Xenohide Gloves
effect: Grants the wearer +10% parry and +10% area attack damage.

name: Overcharge Gloves
effect: Whenever the wearer uses overcharge on a plasma weapon, that attack ignores enemy‘s deflection and deals +(2 x (INT bonus + BS bonus))% additional damage.

name: Arsonist's Bracers
effect: These bracers grant the wearer a +5 bonus to Tech-Use and increase the damage from flame weapons by +3.

name: Plasmashaper Gloves
effect:
These gloves grant the wearer a +10 bonus to Tech-Use.
They also increase the damage of plasma weapons by +3.

name: Inevitable Demise
effect: The wearer's critical hits deal double damage.

name: Heavy Lifters
effect:
The wearer gains +30 Strength.
If the wearer has not moved the previous turn, their ranged attacks with heavy weapons deal +50% damage until the end of turn.

name: Helliarch's Gloves
effect: Attacks ignore cover effects.

name: Bullet Hell Gloves
effect: Increases the rate of fire of the wearer's weapon by +1. Each time an enemy is killed, perplexed is inflicted on all other enemies in a 2-cell radius.

name: Undying Rage
effect: Each melee attack performed by the wearer increases their armour by AGI bonus% until the start of their next turn.

name: Fine Work Gloves
effect: The wearer gains +25 Demolition and +25 Tech-Use.

name: Commander's Gloves
effect: At the end of the turn, the wearer gains stacks of tactical advantage equal to the number of enemies they hit during their turn.

name: Warp Conductor Gloves
effect:
After triggering a psychic phenomena or perils of the warp:
Wearer's psy rating is increased by +1 until the end of combat.
Wearer gains momentum and temporary wounds equal to their resolve.
Can only be equipped by an unsanctioned psyker.

name: Exoskeletal Gloves
effect: The wearer gains +10 Strength and +5 Toughness.

name: Abyss Spinner Gloves
effect: Allies targeted by the wearer's abilities gain +20% of the wearer's armour penetration and +30% of the wearer's critical damage for 1 round. If that ally scores a critical hit by the start of the wearer's next turn, the wearer's next attack is always a critical hit.

name: Abyssal Conduit
effect: Every second use of a psyker staff's unique psychic power deals + (2 x Willpower Bonus) additional damage.

name: Astartes Power Gloves
effect: The Space Marine's recoil is decreased by -20. The Space Marine's melee attacks also apply staggered on the targets if they fail a Toughness resistance test with a -20 penalty.

name: Bladedancer's Bracers
effect: Each hit made with Blade Dance increases the wearer's critical hit chance by +(2 x WS bonus) until the end of the wearer's turn.

name: Bounty Hunter's Gloves
effect: Whenever the wearer kills a target marked as prey, they gain a +(prey's difficulty tier)% bonus to damage until the end of combat. This effect stacks.

name: Breacher's Bracers
effect: Whenever the wearer pushes the target, the wearer's next attack against that target in the same round deals +10% damage. Stacks.

name: Claws of the Black Hunt
effect: Whenever the wearer performs a melee attack on an enemy, that attack inflicts +1 stack of the black hunt effect. If an enemy has at least 1 stack of black hunt, each attack from an ally on that enemy inflicts 1 more stack of black hunt. Each stack of black hunt grants +1% critical hit chance and +1% critical damage to all attacks against that creature.

name: Compensator Gloves
effect: The wearer ignores weapon recoil while performing ranged burst attacks. The rate of fire of the wearer's weapon is increased by +(Ballistic Skill / 2)%. Rate of fire is rounded down to the nearest integer.

name: Crimson Oblivion
effect: If worn by a Death Cult assassin, whenever the wearer kills an enemy, that enemy explodes in a fountain of blood. The cells nearby are covered in blood as if affected by blood phial.

name: Crusade Plate Gloves
effect:
Whenever the wearer deals damage with a heavy weapon to an enemy, that enemy suffers +1 stack of perplexed.
If 3 or more stacks of perplexed are already on the target, the wearer's attacks also inflict staggered for 2 rounds.

name: Enforcer Light Carapace Gloves
effect: Whenever the wearer pushes an enemy with a melee attack, that enemy suffers -20 armour and dodge until the wearer's next turn. That enemy also must pass a Toughness resistance test with a -30 penalty or become immobilised until the wearer's next turn.

name: Executioner's Gauntlets
effect: Increases the critical damage of Where It Hurts (including the damage from the attack itself and from extra instances of damage-over-time effects) by +(Medicae / 5).

name: Heartseekers Gloves
effect: Whenever the wearer scores a critical hit for the first time in combat, the damage dealt by this critical hit is increased by +50%. This effect resets after they or their ally perform a heroic act or a desperate measure.

name: High Spinner Gloves
effect: Increases the critical damage of Where It Hurts (including the damage from the attack itself and from extra instances of damage-over-time effects) by + (Medicae / 5).

name: Kasrkin Gauntlets
effect: These gauntlets grant the wearer a +10% bonus to critical hit chance. This bonus doubles if the wearer has not moved during their turn.

name: Knuckle-Dusters
effect: These knuckle-dusters grant the wearer a +10 bonus to Coercion.

name: Master Duellist's Gloves
effect: Whenever the wearer scores a critical hit with a ranged attack, their next attack against any target automatically hits and cannot be parried or dodged.

name: Metal Claw Gloves
effect: Whenever the wearer hits a target with a melee attack, the target's armour is reduced by -2% until the end of combat. Stacks.

name: Pain Grip
effect: All the wearer's melee attacks inflict bleeding (4). All bleeding effects inflicted by the wearer have their power increased by +2.

name: Radiant Gloves
effect: This item grants the wearer a +5 bonus to parry reduction. If the wearer has Conviction — Iconoclast, all allies gain +(10 + 2x Iconoclast)% hit chance against enemies adjacent to the wearer. The wearer automatically dodges allies' melee attacks.

name: Relished Anguish
effect: At the end of the wearer's turn, they gain temporary wounds equal to the amount of collision damage inflicted by the wearer this turn.

name: Stabilising Gauntlets
effect: When the wearer uses Run and Gun, they gain +(AGI bonus/3) damage on their ranged attacks and do not suffer winded.

name: Tear-Blade Gloves
effect: The wearer's damage is increased by +1% for every 2% of wounds lost.

name: Grox Bracers
effect: This sturdy hand protection increases Parry by 10.

name: Sapper Gloves
effect: These gloves grant a +10 bonus to Demolition Tests.
